dataset_metadata.name: Game Recommendation RAG Dataset
dataset_metadata.schema_goal: RAG-ready game recommendation and description chatbot

normalization_rules.missing_values: JSON null; the string 'N/A' is not used
normalization_rules.date_format: ISO-8601 YYYY-MM-DD when exact; otherwise release_year + release_date_precision
normalization_rules.platform_semantics: access_type distinguishes native/current-gen, port/upgrade, and backward compatibility
normalization_rules.price_semantics: reference USD band, not live storefront price
normalization_rules.gameplay_hours_semantics: approximate min-max planning range; null for endless/session-based games
normalization_rules.language_semantics: representative localization profile; platform/region/edition may differ

enhancements: expanded Xbox Series X|S and Nintendo Switch representation
normalized platform release data with explicit null semantics
recommendation features such as difficulty, pace, co-op and family-friendly
quality_notes: The original 36 descriptions and available legacy fields were retained where useful, while inconsistent platform semantics were normalized.
Exact platform dates are only stored when curated with confidence; otherwise the dataset uses year-level precision or null rather than inventing a date.
Prices are stable reference/base-edition bands for budget filtering and are not live sale prices.
Gameplay hours are approximate recommendation ranges rather than authoritative completion-time measurements.
Language profiles are representative and should be store/API-verified if localization guarantees are required.
Ratings for newly added games are left null instead of fabricated; the original seed ratings are preserved.

games.title: Cyberpunk 2077
games.description: Cyberpunk 2077 is an open-world, action-adventure RPG set in the megalopolis of Night City, where you play as V, a mercenary outlaw. The game focuses on a branching narrative, deep character customization, and first-person combat, allowing you to explore a dense cityscape while dealing with themes of transhumanism, corporate power, and the quest for immortality. Key features include a dynamic day-night cycle, various cybernetic enhancements, and multiple endings shaped by your choices.
